text.en: This Order may be cited as the Constitution (Transfer of Functions Citation. and Consequential Provisions) Order, 1990.

In this Order unless the context otherwise requires -Interpretation. "functions" includes any powers, duties, privileges or benefits conferred or imposed by any written law on any person or authority. "Minister" means the person appointed under subsection {4) or

(9) of Section 4 of the Constitution who is for the time being charged with the responsibility for the subject matter to which the written law specified in the Schedule refers.

The functions conferred or imposed on the person or authority Transfer of specified in the first column of the Schedule by the provisions of law functions. specified opposite thereto in the second column of that Schedule are hereby transferred to the person or authority specified opposite thereto in the third column of that Schedule.

SCHEDULE (Article 3)

TRANSFER OF STATUTORY FUNCTIONS First Column Second Column Third Column Person or authority Provisions of Law Person or authority from whom func-concerned to whom functions tions transferred transferred PAWNBROKERS ACT (CHAPTER 63) His Majesty The Section 4(3), (4) and Minister Sultan and Yang (5) Di-Pertuan in Council.

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE SCHEDULE (Cont'd) First Column Second Column Third Column Person or authority Provisions of Law Person or authority from whom func-concerned to whom functions tions transferred transferred PAWNBROKERS ACT (CHAPTER 63) Minister Section 14( 1) and (2) Minister or such other officer as is authorised by him in that behalf by writing Minister Section 15 Minister or such other officer as is authorised by him in that behalf by writing His Majesty The Section 27 Minister with the Sultan and Yang approval of His Di-Pertuan in Majesty The Sultan Council and Yang Di-Pertuan Made this 28th day of June, 1990 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM Dicetak oleh ALI BIN HAJI HASSAN, Pengarah Percetakan, di Jabatan Percetakan Kerajaan, Kementerian Undang-Undang, Negara Brunei Darussalam. Harga B$5.00
